purpose: Bind every Stage-4 input and lock every Stage-4 rule while the outcome is still sealed, so no method, weighting, denominator or success definition can be chosen in the light of a result.
why_this_stage_is_different: every earlier stage could be rerun if a rule proved wrong. Stage 4 cannot: once the correspondence is computed the outcome is open and no later choice is outcome-blind. Everything choosable is chosen now.

INHERITED_NOT_RESTATED.principle: the statistic, estimand, weighting, nuisance basis, bootstrap, success criterion and anti-false-green controls already live in frozen contracts. They are bound here by digest, never restated, because a second definition can diverge from the first.

BOUND_PHASE_B_INPUTS.note: Stage 4 reads ONLY these. It may not reopen the RNA or ATAC matrices.

pairing_permutation.note: bound for completeness; Stage 4 does not need it, because the substrate it reads is already paired

ESTIMATOR_IMPORTED_UNMODIFIED.rule: Stage 4 must import this file unmodified and verify its sha256 before use. A changed estimator is a changed method, whatever the diff looks like.
forbidden: re-tuning the adjustment model after seeing correspondence
inventing a nuisance function after the outcome

METHOD_LOCKS.per_donor_per_pair_statistic: Pearson correlation between the metacell-level RNA value of the linked gene and the metacell-level ATAC value of the assigned peak set, computed ACROSS that donor's metacells.
METHOD_LOCKS.pearson_is_primary_spearman_is_sensitivi: The estimator lineage operates on continuous residualised scores and a correlation on log1p-normalised values is the quantity its synthetic qualification was built around. Spearman is predeclared as a sensitivity arm, not as an alternative primary.
METHOD_LOCKS.sign_convention: POSITIVE means higher distal accessibility accompanies higher linked-gene RNA. The one-sided hypothesis is that linked pairs show MORE positive correspondence than matched controls. Sign convention is fixed here and may not be flipped after the outcome.

missing_rules.zero_coverage: If the gene has zero RNA counts in ALL of a donor's metacells, or the assigned peak set has zero ATAC counts in ALL of them, the correlation is UNDEFINED. That (donor, pair) cell is recorded as MISSING. It is NEVER recorded as zero: zero would assert an observed absence of correspondence where there was no measurement.
missing_rules.degenerate_variance: If either vector has zero variance across a donor's metacells, the cell is MISSING for the same reason.

METHOD_LOCKS.primary_estimand: Delta = the donor-averaged, GENE-BALANCED mean difference between the residualised correspondence score of linked E2 edges and that of their matched controls.
METHOD_LOCKS.gene_balancing: Within a donor, the statistic is the mean over genes of the within-gene mean over that gene's edges. This prevents genes carrying many edges from dominating: 3,528 of 5,253 genes carry more than one edge, one carries 68, and 91.7% of edges belong to multi-edge genes.

weighting_hierarchy.non_selection_rule: Disagreement among the three weighting views is REPORTED. It is never resolved by promoting whichever weighting is outcome-favourable.

uncertainty.rationale: matches the frozen P1S bootstrap configuration so the project's uncertainty machinery is unchanged
uncertainty.also_reported: Kish effective sample size over donors, and the donor count behind every interval

METHOD_LOCKS.inference: ONE-SIDED. The prospective hypothesis is that linked pairs show GREATER correspondence than matched controls. The one-sided lower confidence bound at 95% is the reported quantity.
METHOD_LOCKS.multiplicity: NONE REQUIRED for the primary, because the primary is a single set-level estimand. Any edge-level or gene-level statistic is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, must be labelled as such, and may not be converted into a success claim by selecting significant edges.

R1_PRIMARY_EXACT_A_SIDE.governs: the exact randomisation reference for the primary linked-versus-CONTROL_A contrast on edges whose CONTROL_A support is small

R2_EXACT_JOINT_AB.governs: the CONTROL_A versus CONTROL_B null calibration reference

R3_EXACT_CONDITIONAL_ON_REALISED_LARGE_A.governs: the CONTROL_A versus CONTROL_B null calibration reference for pairs where a full joint cannot be materialised. It governs NOTHING in the primary linked-versus-control contrast.

NULL_AND_STRATA_LOCKS.R3_pooling_forbidden: pooling an R3 quantity with R1 or R2 quantities, or comparing them side by side, without that label present
NULL_AND_STRATA_LOCKS.control_B_role: NULL AND CALIBRATION ONLY. CONTROL_B may never enter the primary linked-versus-control contrast and may never alter Phase-A retention.
NULL_AND_STRATA_LOCKS.no_silent_pooling: Any statistic pooled across strata must be accompanied, in the same table, by its per-stratum values. Pooling without the breakdown is a contract violation.

PASS_requires_all_of: the control-vs-control null contrast is not distinguishable from zero (see ANTI_FALSE_GREEN)
no material linked-vs-control covariate imbalance: worst standardised mean difference across the 14 frozen features <= 0.25 after matching
support is not concentrated: the top 1% of donors contribute <= 10% of the weight in the primary statistic

no_minimum_effect_size.why: M_MIN = 0.010 is the frozen margin for the SYNTHETIC benchmark's score scale. Transferring it to a real correlation-difference scale would be an unjustified change of units dressed as a frozen threshold. No defensible minimum effect can be derived prospectively on this scale from anything currently frozen.
no_minimum_effect_size.consequence: The effect magnitude is REPORTED WITHOUT A THRESHOLD. A statistically positive but negligibly small Delta must be reported as exactly that, and must NOT be presented as biological confirmation. p < 0.05 alone is explicitly NOT the success definition.

FAIL_is_reported_with: the donor count and Kish ESS

anti_false_green.name: CONTROL_VS_CONTROL_NULL
anti_false_green.construction: the two independent control draws are contrasted against each other through the identical pipeline
anti_false_green.requirement: must not show excess. A nonzero control-vs-control contrast indicates the pipeline itself manufactures a difference, and any linked-vs-control result is then uninterpretable.
anti_false_green.if_it_fails: STOP. Do not report the primary as a biological result.

anti_false_green.name: COVARIATE_BALANCE
anti_false_green.requirement: worst |standardised mean difference| across the 14 frozen features <= 0.25 between linked and matched control

anti_false_green.name: SUPPORT_CONCENTRATION
anti_false_green.requirement: top 1% of donors contribute <= 10% of the primary statistic's weight; Kish ESS over donors reported

anti_false_green.name: PAIRING_CORROBORATION
anti_false_green.requirement: the blocking pairing precondition passed, with its exact mismatch counts reported

SUCCESS_CRITERION_FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_RESU.the_rule_that_is_easiest_to_break: p < 0.05 is explicitly NOT the success definition. A statistically positive but negligibly small Delta must be reported as exactly that and must not be presented as biological confirmation.

FAIL_CLOSED_GATES.rule: every bound input digest must match before a single correspondence value is computed
the estimator sha256 must equal the bound value
Stage 4 may not open the RNA or ATAC h5ad files; it reads the frozen substrate only
the metacell partition must be the persisted one, verified by digest, never recomputed
the primary must be GENE_BALANCED with the PROMOTER_EQUAL companion emitted in the same table
donor cluster bootstrap, 4000 replicates, seed 20260929; donors are the sole resampling unit
the randomized-null denominator must be 10654, with forced and partially forced pairs excluded and B-unavailable reported as NOT_EVALUABLE
every R3-derived quantity must carry CONDITIONAL_ON_REALISED_LARGE_ARM and may not be pooled with R1/R2
CONTROL_B may not enter the primary contrast
a nonzero control-vs-control contrast makes the primary uninterpretable
FAIL_CLOSED_GATES.on_failure: STOP, do not report the primary as a biological result

FAIL_CLOSED_GATES.rule: no disease, demographic or protected attribute; Morabito untouched; TD60 blocked; training off
effect magnitude is reported without a minimum-effect threshold and p<0.05 alone is not success
the attrition funnel must reconcile to 20,709
no statistic may be pooled across randomness strata without its per-stratum breakdown in the same table

WHAT_STAGE_4_MAY_NOT_READ: the NIH-CARD RNA or ATAC h5ad matrices
any disease, demographic or protected attribute
Morabito or any protected validation outcome
the paired recoverability TEST donors for any recoverability selection

AUTHORISATION_IS_NOT_GRANTED_HERE.statement: this artifact defines what Stage-4 execution authority would require. It does not grant it.
AUTHORISATION_IS_NOT_GRANTED_HERE.granting_requires: an explicit decision after this contract and its tests are independently audited
